part.text:
Now I understand the issue. In CharField.__init__, line 1013 always appends MaxLengthValidator regardless of whether max_length is None or not. According to the issue description, this should be changed to only append the validator when max_length is not None, similar to how BinaryField does it.

Let me make the fix:
